newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish youth injured by "Internet bomb".
newsitem.headline: Finnish youth injured by "Internet bomb".

text.p: Two Finnish teenagers blew themselves up with a home-made bomb they were building using a recipe they found on the Internet, police said on Monday.

The two 16-year-olds may face charges over the explosion, which injured one of them and was Finland's second "Internet bomb" in a week. No one else was hurt but about 60 people were evacuated from the building in a northern Helsinki suburb.

One of the boys told daily Iltalehti that he had watched as his friend's fingers were almost blown off while he was manipulating a small quantity of the explosive cocktail. He said he had not understood how dangerous the chemicals were.

"The thing is they were using materials which are freely available," police commissioner Olli Koski said, referring to the household items which are listed on several Internet sites alongside their chemical names and a list of recipes for explosive devices.
